svg.text: Q01 · Correct meter connections
Connect meters to the right places
Post-16 · ages 16–19
Voltage is measured across two points. Current is measured by putting
the meter into the current path. Never connect a current meter directly
across the supply.
Your investigation
Trace the series current path and identify the voltage connections before
running the circuit.
This activity
Prepare an ammeter/voltmeter test circuit, then compare readings for a
known load. Use V Ω–COM for voltage/resistance and A–COM for
current.
Getting started
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
DMM1 measures OUT relative to the return. DMM2 is in the return path:
its A jack connects to I_RET and its COM jack to ground.
Explain:
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
measurements.
